snippet.title: Don’t close your eyes… Perceptum is coming. Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo available now on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Something is wrong when you close your eyes.
In Perceptum, doubt is constant.

You play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family inside a house where perception cannot be trusted.
Close your eyes to hear what lies beyond.
Look into the mirror to reveal what should not exist.
Question every sound, every reflection, every silence.

This is the official announcement trailer for Perceptum, a psychological horror experience focused on unease, listening, and loss of perception.

Don’t close your eyes.
The house is listening.
